searchText: Hey pandaops can you please disable IP banning on your epbs-devnet-1 nodes? We can't test anything in our nodes due to bans <@&595683609080365088> is there a flag on prysm to disable IP banning? Yes, standby Pandaops, please increase the CollocationLimit=5 too --p2p-colocation-whitelist=0.0.0.0/0 That effectively disables colocation bans
